query: As of July 13 2026, what is the current status of the Eastern Pacific hurricane season? Are there any active tropical storms or disturbances being monitored by NHC that could become named storm Elida (5th storm) or later? List all named EPAC storms of 2026 so far with formation dates, and any current NHC tropical weather outlook areas of interest east of 140W.
answer:
I've completed my research on the 2026 Eastern Pacific hurricane season status as of July 13, 2026. Here's the key summary:

## Bottom line
**On July 13, 2026, storm Elida (the 5th named storm) had NOT yet formed.** On that date it existed only as a high-probability NHC disturbance/area of interest. It became Tropical Depression Five-E on **July 14** and was named **Tropical Storm Elida at 09:00 UTC July 15, 2026**.

## Named EPAC storms of 2026 through July 13 (4 storms, all tropical storms, no hurricanes yet)
1. **Amanda** — formed June 2, 2026
2. **Boris** — formed June 7, 2026 (impacts on southern Mexico)
3. **Cristina** — formed June 8, 2026 (flooding in Central America)
4. **Douglas** — formed ~July 1, dissipated ~July 5, 2026

Official 2026 EPAC name order: Amanda, Boris, Cristina, **Douglas**, **Elida**, Fausto, Genevieve, Hernan — confirming Elida is the 5th name.

## NHC areas of interest east of 140°W (~July 12–13)
- The **pre-Elida tropical wave south of Mexico**, given **90% (7-day) / 40% (48-hr)** formation odds on July 12 — the highest-probability area.
- A **high-chance development area** several hundred miles south of central-western Mexico (next candidate name Fausto).
- Multiple **ITCZ/monsoon-trough disturbances** (reported as ~3 "moderate" + 1 "high" chance areas).

Strengthening El Niño and very warm SSTs (~30 °C off Mexico) were driving rapid back-to-back development. As of the latest data (July 18), Elida remained an active tropical storm and was forecast to become the season's first hurricane.

One data caveat: some media outlets initially mislabeled the 4th storm ("Douglas") or the next name ("Emilia"), but the authoritative WMO/NHC list confirms **Douglas** (4th) and **Elida** (5th).
